## What Thu does

Full-stack web and mobile development: intuitive UIs with React / Next.js, back-end systems with PHP / Laravel and Node.js / Express / NestJS, AWS cloud infrastructure, and DevOps on Linux (Ubuntu) servers. Also builds automation, bots, and AI-assisted tools (OpenAI, RAG).

## Projects

- Friend Debt Tracker (Oct 2026): Mobile app for tracking money lent between friends: two-sided confirmations, auto reminders, history, and 30-day trash. React Native, TypeScript, Firebase, FCM.

- Online Wedding Invitation (Oct 2026): Online wedding invitation in two editions for the 29 Dec 2026 wedding. https://hang-thinh.pages.dev
- Digital Storefront (2025): Storefront for accounts, courses, and downloadable content, with cart, PayPal checkout, gift codes, and an admin console. Australian client. Next.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, Prisma, PayPal, RAG.
- eSIM Shop (2025): eSIM shop with country catalogs, checkout, top-ups, order history, referrals, loyalty, and an admin. Australian client. Next.js, MySQL, Prisma, Cloudflare R2.
- AI Auto-Reply (2025): AI auto-reply SaaS for Slack, LINE, Chatwork, and Facebook Messenger, creating Google Calendar tasks from conversations. Japanese client. React, TypeScript, Express, MongoDB, Stripe, OpenAI.
- Service Booking (2023): Service booking platform with customer web app, mobile app, vendor portal, and admin console. Singapore client. React, TypeScript, React Native, Node.js, MySQL, Stripe.
